R-1.title: Documented parameter restrictions are hard constraints
R-1.text: Any restriction the source states on a parameter (header, comment, README, input instructions) is a hard constraint on every set, on top of G3. Example: MohrCoulombAbaqus.for:14-15 '4) friction angle, phi [degrees] Cannot be set to zero / 5) dilation angle, psi [degrees] Cannot be set to zero' -> 0 < psi <= phi in every set. Each such restriction is recorded in the row's validity block.
applied_to: baw-de MohrCoulomb set B psi 0 -> 3 deg

R-2.title: Author-kept constants and switches are exempt from G4
R-2.text: Constants labelled author-kept (the author's value for this routine, or the author's instruction such as '(insert 1.0)') and integer/flag switches keep their value in every set and are exempt from G4's >=30% / >=20% move rule. G4 is met by the remaining constants.
R-2.reading_of_G4_for_vera: The >=30%/>=20% move rule is the fallback route of G4 ('where only one class member is sensible'). When set B is a different material of the same class (the preferred route), individual constants may coincide or move less (e.g. nu 0.30 vs 0.33, Mazars eps_cu1 3.5 per mille for both classes); the row states the route in each set's 'independence' field. Vera to confirm this reading.
R-2.vera_condition_on_G4_reading: Accepted by Vera (re-check) on conditions: a different-material set B is a named, different member of the class; constants coincide only where the class value genuinely does; mechanism constants (threshold, rate, growth, damage) differ on every route. Every set B carries g4_route in {different_material, same_material_fallback}; different_material sets list coinciding_constants for review.

R-3.title: Label author-other-context split from looked-up
R-3.text: author-other-context = a value the same author published in another context than this routine and its deck (README usage example, a sibling routine or deck, the author's other fit, the author's design file whose points the council designates). looked-up = a value from a publication or dataset that Scout fetched and verified. Both count only in the council tier (D-21a c).
applied_to: abuganza LHS design points (D-21a b, corner rule)
hml E0/Eepsilon (author's own paper and sibling code)

R-4.title: A publication-attributed value stands only once Scout has verified it
R-4.text: A value attributed to a named publication, standard or table is labelled looked-up and stands only after Scout has fetched the source and quoted it (d21_lookups.json); until then it carries verification='pending ...' and the row cannot run. 'As recalled' is never a basis or a fallback. Only uncited handbook-level values may be class-typical. The builder asserts both (no 'as recalled'; no class-typical constant whose basis cites a table, standard or author).
pending: L-EC2-1: EN 1992-1-1 Table 3.1 and fib MC2010 eq. 5.1-9 for the Mazars sets (row on licence hold anyway)

R-5.title: Record CELENT, 3D-only formulation and KINC==1 STATEV resets per row
R-5.text: Each row records: celent (whether CELENT enters the response and the council element size, a non-PROPS choice); formulation_3d_only (the code hard-codes 6 stress/DDSDDE components, so only NTENS=6 elements are admissible: BAM, calculix, compas iso, compas transverse-iso, CriticalSoil, Christensen); kinc1_statev_reset (code that resets STATEV when KINC==1, which re-zeroes state at the first increment of every step: Hashin, Mazars; KSTEP==1 & KINC==1 resets: HFE, thealanjason).

R-6.title: Acceptance and amendments live outside the frozen file
R-6.text: d21_selection_rule.json is never edited. Acceptance (D-21a in the council decisions.md) and every change (this file and later numbered amendments) are separate files with their own sha256; rows carry selection_rule_ref and amendment_ref.

R-7.title: Measured or looked-up values are kept unless they violate G2
R-7.text: A measured or looked-up value is kept unless it violates G2. If it does, prefer shrinking the element (council CELENT) over changing the value; if the value must be raised, record the measured value, its source and the reason.
applied_to: Hashin set B: measured G2+ = 0.2774 and G6 = 0.7879 kJ/m2 (Camanho 2007 Table 3 p.40) kept; council CELENT 0.15 mm (needs Lc <= 0.18 mm for Gmc, <= 0.65 mm for Gmt); mapping the code's matrix-compression energy to G6 is labelled interpreted

R-8.title: Family text updates
R-8.cartilage: E0 = 4.63 MPa with Eepsilon = 3670 MPa (the author's pair: Sajjadinia et al. 2019 Table 1; bioumat SUBROUTINES.FOR:270-271). Set B = osteoarthritic cartilage, Eepsilon = 917.5 MPa (author Table 1, degenerated) passed via PROPS(2), because SDVINI sets STATEV(1)=1 (:160) and the code's own OA override (:328-329, STATEV(1) /= 1) is never reached.
R-8.polymers: Eyring-Leonov: activation energy from the looked-up Ree-Eyring process II (iPP 158.0 kJ/mol, van Erp 2012 Table 2.2; HDPE 141 kJ/mol, Kanters 2015 Table 2.3), unit conversion to mJ/mol labelled interpreted, choice of process II chosen; HDPE mu = 0.415 looked-up (Kanters Table 2.3). v* is the shear-form activation volume in this code (vp_leonov_model.f:94 with C2 = sqrt(1/2)*||s||); the thesis V values are not adopted because the theses' defining equations (shear vs tensile form) have not been quoted, so v* = R*T/tau* stays chosen. A* is set by the yield rule (chosen).
R-8.fibre_composites: Set B cites Camanho, Maimi, Davila 2007 (Compos Sci Technol 67:2715; NASA NTRS 20070035071) Tables 1, 2 and 5 for E1, E2, G12, nu12, Xt 2326.2, Xc 1200.1, Yt, Yc, Sl, Gft, Gfc (looked-up), Table 3 for Gmt (looked-up) and Gmc (interpreted); E3, G13, G23, nu13, nu23, Zt, Zc, St, Si, Git, Gic are chosen with the basis stated.
R-8.wood_creep: Axis mapping 1=R, 2=L, 3=T is recorded as interpreted (2=L supported by README and ROT about y; 1=R/3=T inferred from the ROT sign). Reference DOI 10.1016/j.ijsolstr.2026.113923 (constants not available: paywalled).
R-8.growth: D-21a (a): a council total time is allowed when theta_g depends on time only through time/tau with tau a PROPS constant and the law is bounded for t >= 0; recorded as loading_origin=council_choice with T/tau (mholla morph: T=1, T/tau = 4.0 and 2.5).
R-8.elasticity: D-21a (d): a source with write-only STATEV is 'elastic with output state'; deterministic NaN of the original goes to undefined_outputs (nan_in_original) and is never compared (Christensen FN at zero stress).

R-9.title: Vera re-check fixes F1-F4 (builder-enforced)
R-9.F1: 'verification' is set only from an explicit map to a name in the matching lookup's values (or also_published_not_requested for Hashin G2+/G6, Scout-quoted in the same lookup) in d21_lookups.json; the builder asserts it. R-9.F3: Builder asserts on same_material_fallback sets (abuganza x5, thealanjason x2) that every non-exempt constant moves >= 20% (elastic: lam, mu, k(bulk), MU, ALPHA, KELAS) or >= 30% (all others) relative to set A.
